params.body:
Replaces #128, which failed one test.

Under the row count on Verkennen, the paragraph that defined a row ("Een regel is één boeking in Bouwsoft …") and said how many days the rows fall on is removed. The count line above it already names the kinds, the place, the people and the period. It is removed in all three views and in the print version.

ExploreLensesTest checked "5 dagen" a second time, and that only matched the removed sentence. It now checks the co-worker row next to the open person (Bart, 5 d), which is what the test is about.

View and test only, no migration. Full suite passes locally except the known sqlite Monday case in WorksheetExportTest, which also fails on main and passes on MySQL in CI.
